free_tier.stated: PREMIUM 3 TB $6.50/mo · MAX 12 TB $16/mo · ULTRA 25 TB $32/mo · ULTIMATE 50 TB $64/mo

egress.terms: VERBATIM per-tier transfer allowance: PREMIUM "30 TB for data transfer/month", MAX "150 TB", ULTRA "300 TB", ULTIMATE "600 TB". So egress is ~12x stored capacity per month, resetting monthly. Not unlimited, but 12 full restores of the whole account per month is effectively unmetered for any read pattern the workload generates.

record.interface_detail: Native rclone backend (`ulozto`, added v1.66, Tier 3), REST/resumable upload API, CDN download links
record.tooling: Rclone `ulozto:`. First-class, not a WebDAV fallback. Needs an app_token from https://uloz.to/upload-resumable-api-beta.
record.chaining: rclone mount or `rclone serve s3`/`serve webdav` in front, then Cloudflare. Single namespace, no chunking needed.
record.limits_note: Rclone backend does NOT implement About/`--drive-*` free-space query (docs say the endpoint is not exposed in the API) so `mfs`/quota policies cannot see remaining space. Declare total size manually. No per-file size limit stated on the price page. No S3 API.
record.reliability_note: Czech provider (Uloz.to/Kramerius) that pivoted from a public file locker to a paid private drive after EU DSM pressure in 2023-24. rclone forum users report no download speed limits and working mounts; Assume the ladder can move.

evidence.proved: user confirms 200 TB/$64 line and 'no file size restrictions', and 'they even give a discount for yearly payments'
